note: The fees in US dollars set by the Citizenship (Passport Fees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (No. 1), from the Government Gazette of January 2024, as NewsDay reported them (the regulations' text, reproduced by Citizenship Rights Africa, timed out from here); no later change was found. A QR-code fee on electronically readable applications reported elsewhere wasn't read, so it isn't added. Validity, times and fees at missions abroad are leads.

sources.title: NewsDay, Govt gives in on passport fees (4 January 2024)
sources.said: GOVERNMENT has bowed down to public pressure over new passport fees by increasing the fees for obtaining the document to US$150, instead of the initial US$200 announced in its 2024 budget proposal. ... According to a Government Gazette issued on Monday this week, the emergency passport will now cost US$250.
